subject: Partner pipeline realignment: NorthPoint territory overlap & account handoffs
messages:
From: Ellie Park <ellie.park@northpoint-consulting.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: partners@techforge.io
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + territory overlap — NorthPoint accounts

Hi Jordan,

Quick note from NorthPoint — we’ve been progressing pilots with three mutual accounts (LumenData, Parkside Health, and Beacon Retail) and it looks like there’s some overlap with TechForge (cc’d). Our reps flagged that two of the accounts were engaged by TechForge’s solutions team while NorthPoint is pursuing platform integrations for the other lines of business. That’s creating confusion on the ground and blocking a combined go-to-market for Q3.

I’m attaching a simple account list (northpoint_account_list.csv) showing engagement status, point people, and a suggested priority. Can you help map which partner should be on which accounts and propose a lightweight handoff so there’s a single partner-facing contact per account? We prefer minimizing friction for the customers and avoiding simultaneous outbound.

Proposed ask: a 30-minute alignment call this week to agree on a pilot set (7–10 accounts) and an account handoff template.

Attachments: northpoint_account_list.csv (csv)

Thanks,
Ellie Park
Head of Partnerships — NorthPoint Consulting
ellie.park@northpoint-consulting.com
+1 (415) 555-0194

---
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellie Park <ellie.park@northpoint-consulting.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + territory overlap — NorthPoint accounts

Ellie — thanks for the clear summary and the CSV. I reviewed the file and I agree we should avoid simultaneous outreach.

Immediate plan I propose:
- Run a quick internal triage to tag accounts by priority (sales-ready, engagement-in-progress, low-touch).
- For the pilot, pick 8 accounts that are closest to contract so both partners can coordinate value props rather than compete.
- Assign a single partner owner per account and share a one-page handoff (I’ll use our account-handoff-template.docx).
- Redwood to host a 30-minute sync this Friday to finalize the pilot list.

Can Sergio and Marissa weigh in on the AE/partner-owner rules and whether any of these accounts are on active RFQs? Ellie — would Friday 10:00am PT work for a quick sync?

Attachments referenced: account-handoff-template.docx (docx)

Best,
Jordan Blake
Head of Partner Sales | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0122

---
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + territory overlap — NorthPoint accounts

Jordan / Marissa — quick internal notes before the sync with NorthPoint: 

Context: some of these accounts are already owned by AEs or are in our pipeline with active SOW discussions. We should avoid reassigning without clear rules. My suggested guardrails: 

- Ownership precedence: existing AE opportunity > partner-sourced > external introductions. If an AE has an active deal (proposal stage or later), we mark that AE as primary and ask the partner to coordinate with the AE.
- Product-split approach: if engagement is clearly for separate product lines (e.g., infra vs MLOps services), we allow dual partner roles but require a single commercial owner.
- Escalation path: any disputed account goes to the regional head (cc: Rodrigo in AMER) with the current pipeline snapshot.

Operational steps for the call:
1) Jordan to present proposed pilot list (8 accounts).
2) Marissa to confirm if any accounts are on active RFQ/SOW and flag those we keep with AE ownership.
3) Agree handoff template fields: account owner, primary contact, scope, next 30d actions, NFRs, disengagement clause.

I also uploaded a short triage checklist to the Drive link (see related_links) — use that during the call.

Sergio
Senior Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
---
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellie Park <ellie.park@northpoint-consulting.com>, partners@techforge.io
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + territory overlap — NorthPoint accounts (pilot confirmed)

Ellie / TechForge team — thanks for the fast responses and to Sergio & Marissa for the internal triage. Quick recap and agreed next steps from the pilot alignment call today: 

Agreements made:
- Pilot set: 8 accounts confirmed for coordinated outreach (LumenData, Parkside Health, Beacon Retail, TerraLogix, Clearline Finance, Horizon Labs, Summit Systems, Meridian Foods).
- Owner assignment: single partner-facing owner per account (see attached CSV for assignments). In cases with active AE opportunities, AE remains primary for commercial negotiations; partners will support technical workshops.
- Handoff doc: we’ll populate the account-handoff-template.docx for each account with scope and 30d actions.
- Measurement: weekly joint pipeline sync (15m) and a shared success tracker (Drive link).

Immediate asks:
1) Ellie — please confirm NorthPoint’s single-point contact for the pilot (name + email) by Monday, 15 Jun.
2) TechForge — confirm your contact and capacity for the 8 pilot accounts.
3) Sergio / Marissa — please push the assigned AE flags into HubSpot and confirm RFQ/SOW exclusions by EOD Monday.

Attachments: pipeline-realignment-slide.pdf (pdf), northpoint_account_list.csv (updated), account-handoff-template.docx

If everyone is aligned I’ll open a shared HubSpot deal (link above) and schedule the first weekly 15m sync for next Wednesday. Thanks all — glad we landed on a cooperative approach.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Head of Partner Sales | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0122
